findings.description: There is no independent role-access expansion. audit rejects owner='role' immediately, and audit_role_access does not exist. Consequently E5/E6/W2/W3 have declaration strings and callable primitives but no accounting that establishes their required primitive accesses. Both adapter instances of the dedicated acceptance sentinel fail. Deferring role domain semantics to d2 does not defer this child's explicitly assigned declaration/access foundation.

The claimed all-rule inventory is incomplete. COMPUTED is absent, so Evidence digest inputs and TestPlan authored-content operands are not declared as required by the sealed plan and the failing computed-input sentinel. CompetingSet.members also declares only mapping shape, kind and residual description; it does not declare the conditional exact Hypothesis reference for named members. The literal test inventory repeats that omission, so dictionary equality cannot establish complete dependency coverage.

prepare validates scope pins and enumerates kinds, then discards the collection results. It neither establishes root membership relative to the checked scope nor records checked active/inactive rule obligations. Receipt has no inactive accounting, and both checked-inactivity sentinel instances fail. The unconditional role-semantics diagnostic prevents a complete clean result, but does not fulfill the planned scope and applicability foundation.

Expected obligations are a second manually executed recipe, not an exhaustive expansion of declarations. The manifest supplies a contract only after a recipe requests a path; nothing reconciles declared active fields with requested paths. In isolated direct and SQLite-reader probes, adding the same required text field to the manifest and live Evidence declarations, leaving it absent and unread, still produced no diagnostics and successful support. Removing every entry from lint_context.RULES likewise left successful auditing unchanged. Comparing the two execution traces therefore cannot detect all omitted rules or unconsumed declarations.

Exact event-list equality rejects valid graphs because expansion and preparation traverse collections in different orders. Expansion.media validates each ingestion immediately, whereas the temporal preparer first resolves all candidate media edges. Expansion.observation resolves all evidence edges before preparing evidence, whereas the preparer resolves and prepares each in turn. Independent probes found no baseline diagnostics but an accounting mismatch for two valid ingestions on direct and in-memory SQLite paths, and for two valid observation evidence references on the direct path. Single-member fixtures conceal this defect.

Focused controls do not cover every newly introduced validator and access branch as sealed. The new role field matrix exercises only Hypothesis.confidence; role edge resolution, exact-history access and prediction-key path handling have no isolated valid/negative controls. Accounting substitution tests target only temporal Evidence.coverage, and there are no controls for unread declarations or per-association occurrence substitution. Existing generic boundary tests cannot prove that this new wiring invokes the correct boundary and dependency checks.
